description: An app sidebar whose current-page key glides between items, that narrows to an icon rail, and that slides in over the page on a phone.
keyboard: Moves between the trigger and the items.
Opens the focused item, or folds a collapsible group from its label.
Closes the sidebar while it is a sheet on a phone, and puts focus back on the page's trigger.

propDocs.SidebarProvider.collapsed: Whether the sidebar is narrowed to the icon rail. Pass it to control the sidebar.
propDocs.SidebarProvider.onCollapsedChange: Runs when the sidebar wants to narrow or widen, with `details.reason` (`"trigger-press"` or `"imperative"`).
propDocs.SidebarProvider.openMobile: Whether the sheet is open on a narrow screen. Pass it to control the sheet.
propDocs.SidebarProvider.onOpenMobileChange: Runs when the sheet wants to open or close, with `details.reason`: `"trigger-press"`, `"item-press"`, `"escape-key"`, `"outside-press"` or `"breakpoint"`.
propDocs.SidebarProvider.mobileBreakpoint: Provider width below which the sidebar becomes a sheet.
propDocs.SidebarProvider.speed: How fast the sidebar moves: `"fast"`, `"normal"`, `"slow"` or a multiplier like `0.8`.
propDocs.SidebarMenuButton.isActive: Marks the current page for the moving highlight.
propDocs.SidebarMenuButton.tooltip: Names the item with a native tooltip while the sidebar is a rail.
propDocs.SidebarGroup.collapsible: Lets the group label fold its content.
propDocs.SidebarGroup.defaultOpen: Initial expanded state of a collapsible group.
